name: SOON Izakaya
address: Cluster P, Armada Tower 2 - Sheikh Zayed Rd - Al Thanyah Fifth - Jumeirah Lakes Towers - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Discover SOON Armada an authentic Izakaya in JLT's Armada Tower 2, New Dubai. Infusing Tokyo-raised Izakaya traditions with modern mixology, music, and design,

reviews.author: Ulka Baghirova
reviews.text: Food was amazing, especially the wagyu katsu sando was amazing 😍😍 you should definitely try it!! We ordered spicy tuna sushi, prawn gyoza both were tasty. Location might be hard to find but inside the atmosphere is amazing. Bar part of the restaurant is outstanding. Songs all were old and cool. Service also, waiters are sooo kind. Its kind of vibe you wanna go back to ❤️😍

reviews.author: A JP DUBAI
reviews.text:
Nice atmosphere with a great vibe, especially with the music playing in the background. The menu has a good selection, and the quality of the food was very good overall. Cocktails were well made and enjoyable, which added to the experience.

The staff were extremely helpful and friendly, making the service feel warm and welcoming. A great place to relax, enjoy good food and drinks, and spend a nice evening. Would definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Carlo Caruso
reviews.text: Been forst time to SOON izakaya. Found on a google search and absolutely fantastic. The entrance may seem like you are going to a csr park but then you have a beautiful outdoor seating, indoor seating and also tetro games available like in an arcade without losing the charm of a japanese restaurant. Also cocktails and bar service available at the counter.

reviews.author: Chef Paolo
reviews.text: I had a great experience here! Gourav suggested a sake (not cheap, but amazing)—strong with nice notes. Patricia explained the menu, checked in on me, and made sure everything was great. Chef Jordan made my food and recommended the soft shell crab and salmon sushi—so good, especially the sauce. The karaage tastes like childhood memories. The shrimp gyoza is fresh and you can really feel the shrimp, and the chicken gyoza is a must try. The place is cozy and nice, with great music too. Coming back for sure with my friends!

reviews.author: aian
reviews.text: Had a great experience and delicious food with my sister. The place has a cozy vibe, and our server, Arjun, was very helpful and accommodating. We ordered the soft-shell crab maki, lobster maki, and hamachi sashimi, paired with the Pikachu and Raichu mocktails. Everything was excellent. Thumbs up!

reviews.author: Devika
reviews.text: The atmosphere at Soon was perfect for a night out in the city! It was cozy yet really fun with great music and cocktails! The food and service were really great and i loved the quirky aesthetics. I’m going to be back for the matcha cheesecake and gyoza that stole the show !

reviews.author: Caius Bernardi
reviews.text:
A very nice experience.
Cool environment, I appreciated so much the fusion between modern and traditional, the old Videogames 😊 and the playlist which make me feel so nostalgic.
Food & Beverage offer was quite impressive, both warm and cold options: delicious ghioza and tempura prawns🍤, sushi 🍣 and sashimi as well.
Warm and very attentive service, thanks so much for the complementary dessert.
Very recommended.

reviews.author: pearla kay
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Soon in JLT! The vibe is incredible with a live DJ setting the mood—perfect for a fun night out with friends. The Japanese cuisine is exceptional; every dish is full of flavor and beautifully presented. I highly recommend trying the Eggplant Mochi—so unique and delicious! And for dessert, don’t miss the Soon Cassette—a sweet ending you’ll remember. Amazing atmosphere, great music, and unforgettable food. Catch me there again for sure!

reviews.author: twain tuazon
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Soon Izakaya! The vibe is super chill but lively perfect for a night out with friends or even a casual date. The food and drinks are top-tier, but I have to give a special shoutout to the salmon sushi so fresh, it practically melts in your mouth!! Love the ambiance! What really made the night though was the service everyone was friendly and accommodating. A big thank you to Mar, the host, who was incredibly attentive and made sure we felt taken care of the whole time

reviews.author: Yana Zefirka
reviews.text: I recommend visiting the restaurant SOON Izakaya. The wonderful atmosphere and pleasant music will make your evening unforgettable. The staff is attentive to each guest. Very beautiful interior. All the dishes were very tasty. I recommend trying Smoked salmon and Prawn tempura, it is very tasty. For dessert, I recommend Mochi dessert, it is an incredibly tasty dessert. This dessert is a real paradise for those with a sweet tooth. I will definitely recommend my friends to visit this restaurant. Thanks to the staff for the high level of service.

reviews.author: Y D
reviews.text: Soon Izakaya is a hidden chill gem in JLT, perfect for a relaxed weekday happy hour. The ambiance is cozy and laid-back, with a great happy hour selection. Service was excellent: June was fantastic, and Sushi Chef Darwin at the sushi bar was incredibly accommodating. Friendly people, great service, and an overall awesome spot to unwind. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Bayan Aburkhes
reviews.text: Went with my husband to try the kushiyaki for the first time and was very impressed. The place itself is very cool with amazing music. The atmosphere is great and the service is amazing . All the serves and host were so kind and thoughtful. The skewers were delicious and it was such a fun experience. Excited to visit again and try other menu items

reviews.author: Ahmed Selim
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Soon DXB! The ambiance is trendy yet cozy, making it perfect for both casual hangouts and special nights out. The food was beyond delicious every dish was packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The staff were super friendly and attentive, which really added to the overall experience. Highly recommend trying their signature dishes and creative drinks. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Manami
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Soon Izakaya! The atmosphere is cozy and stylish, perfect for a relaxed night out. Every dish we ordered was packed with flavor—especially the smoked salmon Sushi and Gyoza. The staff was friendly, and made us feel truly welcome. Great selection of drinks too! Will definitely be coming back soon. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Parastoo Ramezani
reviews.text:
Had an absolutely incredible dining experience at SoonDXB—this place is a hidden gem for anyone who loves creative, high-quality Asian fusion.

We started with the Rock Ebi Tempura, and it was the perfect way to kick things off. The prawns were perfectly crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and coated in the most addictive creamy spicy sauce. Honestly, I could eat a whole bowl of just that!

Next up was the Torikatsu, and it did not disappoint. The chicken was tender and juicy, with a light and crispy breading that wasn’t greasy at all. The sauce it came with was rich and flavorful—just the right balance of sweet and savory.

The star of the night for me was the Miso Chilean Seabass. It was absolutely melt-in-your-mouth tender, with that buttery texture you expect from seabass. The miso glaze added a deep umami flavor without overpowering the fish. Hands down one of the best seabass dishes I’ve ever had in Dubai.

We also ordered the Marinated Lamb Rack, which was beautifully cooked and full of flavor. The meat was tender, slightly smoky, and seasoned to perfection. You could really taste the quality in every bite.

Overall, SoonDXB impressed me with both presentation and flavor. Every dish was thoughtfully made, and you can tell they care about quality and detail. Highly recommend this spot if you’re looking for a trendy yet refined dining experience in Dubai.

Can’t wait to go back and try more from their menu!

reviews.author: Paula Díaz
reviews.text: Had a fantastic lunch at Soon Izakaya! The set menu was well-balanced, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Perfect portion sizes and high-quality ingredients. The ambiance is stylish yet relaxed, ideal for a midday break. Friendly service and great value for the quality. Will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Nissa Bey
reviews.text:
A real gem!
I visited this restaurant today and was truly impressed. The food was delicious, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. The service was excellent fast, attentive, and very professional. On top of that, the restaurant has a warm and cozy atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: cherry koo
reviews.text:
There were a lot of dishes that are currently not available as there may be changes soon. Food in general was good, love to clay pot rice and the crepe dessert. However, the portion may be too small for man, and in my opinion it’s slightly over priced. Overall, it’s still a nice place to chill, and perfect for girls gathering as you can order a lot of different dishes to share.

The service was amazing. Some of my friends was plant based and our waiter remembered and gave some good suggestions.

The vibe of the restaurant is good as well, music  and environment are great. It was a lovely izakaya:)

reviews.author: Jig Gu (DubaiJiggy)
reviews.text: Went on a Sunday afternoon for lunch. It was empty. The staff are extremely warm and welcoming. The menu looks great at first glance. Ordered a number of appetizers, didn't have anything that was exceptional or justified the prices. Loved the decor of the place and can see it being nice for Ladies night . Eggplant mochi was nice, soon fried rice was too fishy because of the amount of seaweed in it, wasn't a fan but apparently it's a favorite. Will try the Sandos if I go again.

reviews.author: Diana Hatrakova
reviews.text: They just opened a terrace and let me tell you - this is a place to go! Great vibes, interior and the patio are super ambient. It's the ultimate cool place and kind of a hideaway from all of those rushy, touristy spots. The food was absolutely incredible, lamb neck and sushi are a must try when you go! Oh and mochis were to die for! Staff was super friendly and helpful, especially our server (I remember his name started with U but unfortunately can't recall exactly, either way I wanna say big thanks). I think it's my new go to spot for Japanese cuisine or just a fun cocktail night out, as the drinks were really tasty too  🤩

reviews.author: Andy Summers - Salas
reviews.text:
This has become my go to spot whenever I am not at work or just need a place to get things done with delicious food and genuinely great service. Living right in the next cluster makes it even better. I think I have tried almost every dish on the menu, and my tummy has always left happy.

Several months ago, the service team seemed a little down and depressed, but on my recent visits, I was pleasantly surprised to see the same familiar faces now full of energy and smiles. It is great to see such a positive change.

I rated the ambiance three stars only because smoking is allowed indoors, which I understand is part of the restaurant’s policy. Regardless, it remains one of my favorite places for good food and even better people!

reviews.author: Юлия Гусаченко
reviews.text: This style restaurant is the perfect place for a fun and unforgettable night out. The atmosphere is lively and welcoming, with a DJ playing great music that keeps the energy high. The cocktails are expertly crafted and delicious, while the food is full of flavor and beautifully presented. The interior design is stunning, creating an immersive and stylish experience. If you love great drinks, music, and a vibrant ambiance, this place is a must-visit!

reviews.author: Arghavan Rahim
reviews.text: SOON DXB is a hidden gem with serious underground vibes. The atmosphere is edgy and unique, the food is bold and flavorful, and the cocktails are top-tier. Plus, the service is super attentive. A must-visit if you’re into cool spots with great energy.

reviews.author: sofy khelifi
reviews.text:
I had an amazing night at soon
🤩 Is a hidden gem in dubai located at Jlt
relaxed, funky & sophisticated at the same time. really good vibes here 🫶🏻👌 with live dj
The food 🥘 and drinks 🍹 very delicious 🤤 The menu has a wide selection of dishes to choose from
The culinary team truly knows how to impress with their innovative and flavorful creations.
The staffs were friendly and helpful 🫶🏻
Very chic interior design ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Highly recommended for anyone in dubai

reviews.author: Yara Gouhary
reviews.text: I had an incredible dining experience at Soon, A  Japanese restaurant in the heart of JLT! The food was absolutely amazing—each dish was packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The DJ added a fantastic vibe to the evening, really elevating the atmosphere. The decoration was also top-notch, elegant, and chic, creating a perfect blend of modern and traditional Japanese aesthetics. Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for delicious food, great music, and a stylish setting! Definitely will be back!😇

reviews.author: Nichole Abarquez
reviews.text:
Had a great experience at Soon in JLT! Darwin made the sushi and it was absolutely delicious — fresh, beautifully prepared, and full of flavor. You can really tell care went into every bite.

June was serving the drinks and did an awesome job too — friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect at the table.

Such a lovely team and a place I’d happily come back to!

reviews.author: Carlo Cecilio
reviews.text: I am very impressed with the food, place, and service at this restaurant. The food was delicious and beautifully presented, the atmosphere was inviting and pleasant, and the staff were attentive and friendly. Overall, a wonderful dining experience. Highly recommended to all my friends, family and my co-workers. Thank you so much SOON! 😍

reviews.author: Nadine Hesham
reviews.text:
I absolutely loved this place! The vibe is fantastic, with great-quality food and a fun atmosphere. The music and DJ are simply awesome.

It was my first time here, and I can't wait to come back! A special thanks to the wonderful staff who made us feel so welcome and displayed such professionalism. ❤️

reviews.author: Юлиана Королёва
reviews.text: I had an amazing time at Soon in JLT, Dubai! This vibrant and youthful spot offers great music with an awesome DJ, delicious food, and good cocktails. The atmosphere is truly lively and welcoming, making it a perfect place to hang out with friends or just enjoy the night. A special thanks to Ernesto for the excellent service and engaging conversation. It was such a pleasure to visit, and I’ll definitely be back! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Yuliia
reviews.text: I had a lovely experience. Design is modern and cozy loft I’m in love. The mocktails were tasty, I tried with grapefruit. The kushiyaki were absolutely delicious - especially the seafood options! Im in love with prawns. Perfectly grilled and full of flavor. Soon is a great spot if you’re looking for quality Japanese bites in a stylish setting. Design is modern and cozy loft I’m in love.
